authority: User message 'MOTAR - Fast Research Hypothesis Validation: H-R3 Pilot' (2026-10-18); exploratory pilot only
status: H-R3 PROVISIONAL; pilot exploratory, not confirmatory

arms.B1: scripted pursuit toward the online tracker belief; yaw 0; no lateral manoeuvre
arms.B3: B2 + lateral velocity toward the nearest clear-line-of-sight viewpoint

controller.inputs: own position/velocity/vehicle quaternion, perception.tracker state (belief), raw LiDAR (task._lidar_distance_m, body origin, rows +20..-10 deg, 72 bearings); no target GT, occlusion class, renderer mask or LiDAR semantics
controller.selection: smallest |offset| whose segment candidate->belief clears every LiDAR point by los_clearance and whose segment drone->candidate clears by path_clearance; ties -> positive offset; none -> 0
controller.safety_filter: for each LiDAR point within 1.5 m (horizontal), remove the velocity component toward it, weight clamp((1.5 - r)/1.0, 0, 1); applied in B1, B2 and B3
controller.after_window: Policy F resumes at reobservation or after W

event.trigger: first step t0 of the env's first episode with camera detection False after True at t0-1, at least one earlier detected step, t0 + W <= steps
event.matched: per-env per-step digests (actor obs row, pursuer state, target state, tracker state, camera flag) identical across the four arms for every step < t0 and identical t0

primary_metric: identity-correct camera reobservation within W: some j in 0..19 with camera detection True and E-L0 renderer target pixels >= 1 after the action at t0+j; denominator = all matched geometric-occlusion events (crash/capture/reset in W before reobservation = failure)
statistics: exploratory: paired exact McNemar, paired bootstrap 95% CI of the difference (10000 resamples, seed 0), Wilson CIs; no confirmatory claim
secondary: capture/timeout/incomplete at W and W+30 steps
target trajectory equality across arms in W
